description.zh:
命令控制配置。

> 仅适用于Linux主机。
description.en:
The command control settings.

> This parameter applies only to Linux hosts.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
指定需要修改的控制策略ID。

> 您可以调用[ListPolicies](~~2758876~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

> You can call the [ListPolicies](~~2758876~~) operation to query the control policy ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 设置指定控制策略的命令控制配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-command-config --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1ghxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 45 --command-config '{"Deny":{"Commands":["mkdir"],"AclType":"white"},"Approval":{"Commands":["mkdir"]}}' --region cn-hangzhou
